name: avatar
title: Avatar
description:
A person, in the space of a word. Every screen that lists people needs one, and the three things that go wrong with it are always the same:
 * - **The picture fails to load** and a broken-image glyph appears where a   face was. The fallback is not a nicety; it is the state this component   spends most of its life in, because half the people in any list have no   picture at all.
